newsitem.title: UK: UK executives see electronics prices static-survey.
newsitem.headline: UK executives see electronics prices static-survey.

text.p: Most British electronics executives expect sales to rise in the next three months, although prices are seen staying static, according to survey results released on Monday.
The survey, conducted by NOP for Electronics Weekly magazine and Schroder Ventures, questioned 150 directors, chairmen and senior executives of electronics businesses.
Some 65 percent of those surveyed reported a rise in sales over the past three months, while 75 percent expected further increases over the next three months.
However, only 14 percent of those surveyed expected to see sales prices rise over the next three months, while 69 percent saw prices remaining static and 17 percent believed they would actually fall.

"In an environment of low or no price rises, a strengthening pound and ever greater competition, growth is increasingly difficult," said Peter Smitham, managing partner at Schroder, adding that the sector needed venture capital to help them grow.
